name: Choice Privileges Select Mastercard
effective_cost: Moderate: the anniversary bonus points and Trusted Traveler credit can offset a large share of the $95 fee for frequent Choice Hotels guests
balance_transfer_fee: $5 or 5% of each transfer, whichever is greater

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $3,000 in purchases within the first 3 months of account opening

verdict.text: Keep for frequent Choice Hotels stays if Platinum status is worth it

earn_rates.category: Choice Hotels stays and Choice Privileges point purchases

earn_note: Double the earn rate of the free Choice Privileges card in every bonused category. Bonus points don't apply to cash advances, balance transfers, fees, interest, or gambling transactions.

redemption_options.method: Free nights at Choice Hotels properties

points.note: Choice Privileges points are a hotel-only currency with no cash, gift card, or travel-portal redemption path; value depends entirely on which property's award chart you redeem against.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners. Choice Privileges is a standalone hotel loyalty program, not a transferable currency.

credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
credits.subtitle: $120 · every 4 years
credits.description: Statement credit up to $120 every four years after the Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee is charged to the card. Shown here amortized to an annual figure.
tips: Apply for Global Entry rather than just TSA PreCheck; it includes TSA PreCheck and covers the same credit.

insurance.detail: Up to $800 per claim against damage or theft when you pay your monthly cell phone bill with this card, minus a $25 deductible, max 2 claims per 12 months
Not responsible for unauthorized transactions once reported

protection_note: Cell phone protection matches the free Choice Privileges card, and this tier adds the Global Entry/TSA PreCheck credit. No purchase protection, extended warranty, rental car coverage, or trip insurance are advertised.
rental_note: No auto rental coverage is publicly documented for this card.

status_perks.name: Platinum Elite status, Choice Privileges
status_perks.note: Automatic Platinum Elite membership gives a 25% points bonus on qualifying stays and 20 Elite Qualifying Nights a year toward requalifying for Platinum, without any stays required.

services.name: 60,000-point welcome bonus
services.detail: 60,000 bonus points after spending $3,000 in purchases within the first 3 months, worth about 7 reward nights at select Choice Hotels properties.

services.name: 30,000-point anniversary bonus
services.detail: 30,000 Choice Privileges points every account anniversary, worth about 3 reward nights, no spending requirement.

services.name: Milestone Rewards
services.detail: Bonus points or gift cards for hitting spending thresholds throughout the year.

services.name: Mastercard World Elite benefits
services.detail: Baseline concierge, travel, and security services included with the card's network tier.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns points on their spend (into your account)

additional_cards.note: No cost to add, and their spending earns the same category rates into your account.
